newsitem.title: CHINA: China province moves out 1.96 mln tonnes grains.
newsitem.headline: China province moves out 1.96 mln tonnes grains.

text.p: China's northeastern Heilongjiang province has started to ship 1.96 million tonnes of grains to other regions to create storage space for the 1997 harvest, a provincial official said on Wednesday.

"We have already started to ship the grain to other regions," an official of the provincial government said by telephone from Harbin, the provincial capital. He did not give the destination of the shipment.

The grains include 1.5 million tonnes of corn, part of a 3.0 million tonne corn shipment shared by Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning provinces and the Inner Mongolia region to the high-consuming south, he said.
The remainder was wheat and rice, he said, but did not give a breakdown.
The government has ordered the grain shipments to ease pressure on stocks and to boost sluggish grain prices in the province, the official said.
China's northeastern provinces shipped two million tonnes of corn to southern provinces in later 1996 and a further 1.5 million tonnes early this year.
